paper.title_en: Cubic Curvature Deformations to the Kerr Black Hole Shadow
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of cubic curvature corrections on the shadows of rotating black holes within the effective field theory of gravity. Starting from a perturbatively corrected Kerr metric incorporating two independent cubic curvature couplings, we construct black hole shadows through numerical integration of null geodesics, without assuming separability of the geodesic equations. Using a Hamiltonian ray-tracing approach, we systematically examine the dependence of the shadow geometry on the higher-curvature couplings, black hole spin, and observer inclination. We find that cubic curvature interactions can produce discernible deviations from the Kerr shadow, modifying its apparent size and shape. In particular, the two cubic interactions exhibit distinct effects on the shadow boundary, with the magnitude of the deviations depending sensitively on the coupling strengths and black hole spin. We validate our numerical results through independent convergence tests of the geodesic integration and shadow-boundary determination, and recover the analytical Kerr shadow in the vanishing-coupling limit. Our results provide a complementary probe of higher-curvature gravity in the strong-field regime and illustrate the potential of black hole shadow observations to constrain departures from general relativity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究高阶曲率（立方）修正对旋转黑洞阴影的影响，属于修改引力中的高阶曲率理论范畴；采用哈密顿光线追踪与数值测地线积分，并做收敛性检验与Kerr极限验证，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较好，适合点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 对Kerr黑洞阴影的立方曲率修正
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在引力的有效场论框架下，立方曲率修正对旋转黑洞阴影的影响。我们从包含两个独立立方曲率耦合的微扰修正Kerr度规出发，通过数值积分零测地线构造黑洞阴影，而不假设测地线方程可分离。使用哈密顿光线追踪方法，我们系统地考察了阴影几何对高阶曲率耦合、黑洞自旋以及观测者倾角的依赖关系。我们发现，立方曲率相互作用可以产生相对Kerr阴影可分辨的偏离，改变其表观大小和形状。特别地，两种立方相互作用对阴影边界表现出不同的效应，偏离的幅度敏感地依赖于耦合强度和黑洞自旋。我们通过对测地线积分和阴影边界确定的独立收敛性检验验证了数值结果，并在耦合消失极限下重现了解析的Kerr阴影。我们的结果为强场区域的高阶曲率引力提供了一种互补的探测手段，并展示了黑洞阴影观测在约束对广义相对论偏离方面的潜力。
